options.name: Description
options.message:
Born in the Reactor is a gripping 2D survival shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world ravaged by a catastrophic Chernobyl meltdown. You play as a lone survivor navigating the eerie streets of Gomel, abandoned hospitals, and a forsaken military base, all leading to the reactor's heart. Battle mutated creatures with limited weapons, uncover the disaster's dark secrets through environmental storytelling, and face a chilling final boss in a tense, atmospheric journey.

With dynamic combat and a haunting soundtrack, the game challenges your survival skills across four levels of increasing difficulty. Use WASD to move, mouse to aim and shoot, and explore to find health kits. The detailed narrative unfolds through the environment, offering a rich experience without excessive dialogue.

options.name: Hotkeys
options.message: WASD/Arrows: Move, Left Mouse: Shoot, 1/2/3: Switch Weapon (Pistol/Rifle/Shotgun), R: Reload, I: Inventory, Enter: Select, ESC: Back, Q: Quit, M: Settings, T: Stats, H: Help
